description: Redesign the analytics, alerts, and reports pages: AlertsPage, TrendsPage, ComparisonPage, ReportsPage, and FitmentPage. className-only changes — preserve ALL JSX, queries, mutations, Recharts configs (only restyle Tooltip contentStyle backgrounds to cream), and form logic. Depends on FEAT-001.
steps: AlertsPage.tsx: title/subtitle->white/light; status + severity selects->input mapping (bg-cream border-gold-border focus:border-brand-gold); alerts table->vanilla header bg-cream-200 text-[#344054], hover #FFF9E8; alert code badge CRITICAL->bg-red-500 text-white, WARNING->bg-amber-500 text-white, else->bg-blue-500 text-white; status badge ACTIVE->bg-red-500 text-white, ACKNOWLEDGED->bg-amber-500 text-white, RESOLVED->bg-slate-500 text-white; 'Action:' text-blue-600->text-brand-gold; resolved note->bg-emerald-500/10 border-emerald-500/30; 'Acknowledge' button->bg-dark-surface text-white border-white/10 hover:bg-dark-card; 'Resolve' button bg-emerald-600->primary gold bg-brand-gold text-black; resolve modal backdrop->bg-black/70, card->bg-cream border-gold-border, textarea->input mapping, 'Cancel'->secondary light, 'Mark Alert Resolved'->primary gold. Keep ackMutation + resolveMutation.

TrendsPage.tsx: title/subtitle->white/light; vehicle selector + time-window pill group bg-white border-slate-200->bg-cream border-gold-border, active day button bg-[#14161A] text-white->bg-brand-gold text-black, inactive text-[#5B6068]->text-slate-500; 'Benchmark Reference' banner bg-slate-50 border-slate-200->dark panel bg-[#17191D] border-gold-border text-slate-300 with title text-white + body text-slate-400; all chart cards bg-white border-slate-200->bg-cream border-gold-border, chart titles text-slate-900->text-[#344054]; set every Recharts Tooltip contentStyle backgroundColor to '#FFFDF5' and borderColor to '#E9D9A5' (keep the emerald THI line, grey dashed baseline, cyan pressure line, orange thermal line as-is); ML evaluation card->bg-cream border-gold-border, 'Held-Out Tabular Evaluation' badge->bg-purple-500/10 text-purple-400 border-purple-500/30, ML metric sub-boxes bg-slate-50->bg-cream-50 border-gold-light with metric values text-slate-900->text-brand-gold, interactive form bg-slate-50->bg-cream-50 border-gold-light, 'Predict Wear'->primary gold, prediction text-purple-700->text-brand-gold. Keep handlePredict + all useQuery.

ComparisonPage.tsx: title/subtitle->white/light; selection drawer card bg-white border-slate-200->bg-cream border-gold-border; selected-count badge valid->bg-emerald-500 text-white, warn->bg-amber-500 text-white; search input->input mapping; warning box bg-[#FFF4EB] border-[#FCD5B5]->bg-amber-500/10 border-amber-500/30 text-amber-400; vehicle chips selected bg-slate-900->bg-brand-gold border-brand-gold text-black with CheckCircle2 text-black, unselected->bg-cream border-gold-light text-slate-500, at-limit->bg-cream-50 border-gold-light text-slate-400; bar chart card->bg-cream border-gold-border (keep Recharts fills); comparison table->vanilla header, hover #FFF9E8, THI pill badges->solid green/amber/red, alert count badge->bg-red-500 text-white, 'Inspect'/'Details' buttons->secondary light. Keep toggleVehicle + selectedIds logic.

ReportsPage.tsx: title/subtitle->white/light; 'Download 13-Sheet Excel' button->primary gold; disclaimer card bg-white border-slate-200->bg-cream border-gold-border; featured dataset card bg-[#14161A] border-[#262A30]->bg-[#17191D] border-gold-border, '13 Sheets Included' badge->bg-cream-100 text-[#344054] border-gold-light, sheet pills->bg-cream-50 text-slate-400 border-gold-light; section heading text-slate-900->text-white; CSV export cards bg-white border-slate-200->bg-cream border-gold-border, label->text-[#344054], download buttons bg-slate-100->primary gold bg-brand-gold text-black; 3 overview cards (Healthy/Warning/Critical)->bg-cream border-gold-border, metric values->text-[#344054], keep emerald/amber/red icon accents. Keep handleDownloadExcel + handleDownloadCsv blob logic.

FitmentPage.tsx: apply the universal mapping across the whole file — title/subtitle->white/light, all cards bg-white border-slate-200->bg-cream border-gold-border, all tables->vanilla header bg-cream-200 text-[#344054] hover #FFF9E8, getLifecycleBadge/getTHIBadge returns->solid green/blue/amber/red white-text badges, primary buttons->bg-brand-gold, charcoal buttons->bg-dark-surface, secondary buttons->bg-cream border-gold-light, modals->bg-cream card + bg-cream-50 inputs + primary gold submit + bg-black/70 backdrop. Do NOT change the PositionData interface, LifecycleType, any useQuery/useMutation, the COMMON_JK_MODELS/COMMON_SIZES arrays, or the fitment/swap/scrap handlers.
acceptance_criteria: All five pages build with npm run build exiting 0.

AlertsPage has solid severity/status badges and a gold 'Resolve' button; TrendsPage chart cards are cream with gold borders and the benchmark banner is a dark panel; ComparisonPage selected vehicle chips are gold; ReportsPage CSV export buttons are gold; FitmentPage tables have vanilla headers.
No interface, API URL, Recharts data binding, mutation, or handler was changed on any of the five pages.
